title: Little Grape Land Recalls Nursing Pillows Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation; Violate Mandatory Standards for Nursing Pillows and Infant Support Cushions
text:
This recall involves Little Grape Land Nursing Pillows. The nursing pillows are U-shaped and come in a rose floral, alligator, bear, butterfly, cactus, construction truck, forest deer, green leaves, little bunny, spring flower and woodland animal patterns. There are no markings or labels on the product.

Hazards: The recalled nursing pillows advertised for infant feeding and tummy time violate the mandatory safety standards for nursing pillows?and infant support cushions?because they can obstruct an infant's breathing, posing a serious risk of injury or death from suffocation.

Remedies: Consumers should stop using the recalled nursing pillows immediately and contact Little Grape Land for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the pillow in half and send a photo of the destroyed pillow to recall@evermorepartner.com.

Consumer Contact: Little Grape Land by email at recall@evermorepartner.com, or online at https://littlegrapeland.com/recall or https://littlegrapeland.com/ and click "Recall" at the bottom of the page for more information.
